Both images show the same text:

**`VISION-OK-739`**

Details of what each returned:

- **`fs.read("vision.png")`** — returned metadata only: `path: "vision.png"`, `mime: "image/png"` (no text field). The image itself rendered as the first attachment, showing the white text `VISION-OK-739` on a dark navy rectangle in the upper-left of a white background.
- **`web.fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8000/vision.png")`** — returned `mime: "image/png"`, `text: "Image fetched successfully"`, `title: "... (image/png)"`. The rendered image (second attachment) is visually identical, showing `VISION-OK-739`.

So the only readable text in the image content is `VISION-OK-739`; the string "Image fetched successfully" is the fetch tool's status message, not text inside the image.
